mapper.insert: INSERT INTO async_dead_message(stream_key,group_name,record_id,message_id,operation_id,topic, error_category,error_detail,delivery_count) VALUES(#{streamKey},#{groupName},#{recordId},#{messageId},#{operationId},#{topic}, #{errorCategory},#{errorDetail},#{deliveryCount}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE error_category=VALUES(error_category),error_detail=VALUES(error_detail), delivery_count=GREATEST(delivery_count,VALUES(delivery_count)),last_seen_at=NOW(3)
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM async_dead_message WHERE last_seen_at < #{cutoff} ORDER BY last_seen_at,id LIMIT #{limit}
